results.title: JCPenney planning 97% of in-store items on sale as holidays near - Mon, 02 Nov 2026 PST
results.description: The crucial holiday shopping season is coming for retailers — and JCPenney is readying some widespread discounts and more. The department store chain is set to put 97% of in-store items on sale, according to a company statement. That offering will last from Nov. 5 to 11. In addition, the Plano, Texas-based company is providing “Really Big Deals” weekly through Dec. 13.
